notes: 6 cases: 4 positive / 2 negative, all golden (authored 2026-09-07 with the skill, before any production trace exists; re-derive the counts from this file before citing them). NOT ONE POSITIVE CONTAINS THE SUBSTRING 'arc', '/loop', OR A DESCRIPTION TRIGGER PHRASE ('run the arc', 'work this unattended', 'keep going until done and clean'): the set exercises the latent clause — an unattended run to a finished AND clean end state, with the human gone — which is the inference path a description rewrite could break without any lexical echo noticing. Negatives are near-misses that belong to /autonomous (a chosen plan with the human present) and /dogfood (a one-off verification with the human waiting). An earlier draft of this file had all four positives as verbatim trigger phrases; P20 round 2 caught it. (The runner pins 'version' to 1; the draft history lives in git.)

known_gaps.routing_contest_untestable_in_isolation: The runner installs only the skill under test, so no case measures arc against /autonomous head-to-head, and their descriptions genuinely overlap on unattended phrasing. The negatives prove arc stays quiet on a bounded task and on a one-off verification; they cannot prove arc loses a routing contest it should lose. Closing this needs a multi-skill workspace mode in the runner.
